name: Heth
title: Son and ancestor of Aram
summary: Heth was one of the sons of Aram, who was a grandson of Shem, Noah's son. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the Semitic people group. Heth is regarded as an ancestor of a people or clan in the ancient Middle East.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Noah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Heth is listed as one of Aram's four sons in the post-flood genealogy, showing the spread of nations from Noah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Shem's lineage
keyEvents.description: Heth is mentioned again as a son of Aram in the more detailed lineage of Shem, which emphasizes the Semitic line.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, the genealogy from Genesis is repeated, and Geter is mentioned as a son of Aram among the descendants of Shem.

keyEvents.title: Part of the origin of the nations
keyEvents.description: Geter is part of the biblical explanation of how the nations arose after the Flood, where each name represents an ancestor to a specific people group or region.
